name: 1N5819
description: 1A Schottky rectifier with low forward drop (~0.45V) and fast recovery. The go-to for switch-mode supplies, polarity protection where every 0.1V counts, and boost/buck freewheeling. The 1N5817/18/19 differ only in reverse voltage (20/30/40V). Banded end is the cathode.

DO-41.notes: axial body; the painted band marks the cathode.

typical_application: Buck/boost converter freewheel diode, low-loss polarity protection, OR-ing supplies, charge pumps. The low drop and fast recovery suit switching above tens of kHz.
gotchas: higher reverse leakage than silicon, and it rises sharply with temperature; not ideal where low standby leakage matters
low reverse voltage (20-40V); do not use on mains rectification
the 1N581x suffix only changes reverse voltage
